Skilled in integrating vector storage, SQL databases, and cloud platforms like AWS and Azure, I built intelligent data-driven solutions also designing, optimizing, and deploying scalable AI workflows, with expertise in end-to-end project delivery that drives automation, efficiency, and impactful business outcomes.

📂 Professional Experience Details:

💼 NTT Data Info Pvt Ltd || Bangalore || Feb 2025 to (Present) as a Sr Gen AI developer (Under NLB Services Pvt Ltd)

💼 ExamRoom.AI India Pvt Ltd || Bangalore || Sep 2023 to Dec 2024 as a Sr Data Scientist

💼 Apsis Technologies Pvt Ltd || Bangalore || June 2020 to Aug 2023 as a Data Scientist

Programming: Python	NumPy	Pandas	Scikit-learn	NLP		SQL	TensorFlow	Keras	PyTorch	OpenCV	CUDA Machine Learning: Linear Regression	Logistic Regression	Decision Trees	Random Forest	Naive Bayes	K-NN  K- Means	Clustering Algorithms		Boosting Algorithms		Principle Component Analysis	Ensemble techniques.

Deep Learning: Deep-NN	RNN	CNN	LSTM	Transformers	Sparks-Hadoop	GANs	YOLO	MongoDB  LLM’s & Generative AI: Large Language Models(LLM’s) LLM's-Fine Tune-Testing-Merging	Pre-training GGUF  PEFT’s	LoRA	Q-LoRA		Prompt-Eng DSPy Text Generation		Unsloth-Training	Machine Translation	AWS	SQL

Management Tools: Project management (Jira)	GitLab	Microsoft Teams	Docker Kubernetes	CI-CD	Azure Devops

Generative AI Tools:- AI-Agents, Lengchain, LangGrah (React-agents), Azure OpenAI, Azure Auto-Rag, ChatGpt.

➵ Education Details:

Bachelor of Technology in Electrical & Electronics Engineering @ Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University-2012

📕 Certification Courses:

IBM-Rag-and-Agentic-Ai Professional certificate from Coursera with IBM.

Large Language Model Operations (LLMOps) Specialization from Coursera with Duke University.

🛠 Responsibilities:

Pre-processed structured/unstructured data from SQL and other sources for LLM, RAG, and agentic AI training.

Implemented RAG workflows with vector storage solutions Chroma, enabling efficient semantic search and knowledge retrieval. Enhanced contextIal text generation with Azure openAI models to improving accuracy and latency.

Built and fine-tuned Large Language Models (Mistral, Llama) for NLP tasks like summarization, Question-Answering systems.

Developed Agentic-AI workflows leveraging LangGraph for orchestrating multi-step reasoning, and intelligent task execution.

Optimized models into GGUF formats (Q-LoRA, PEFT) for efficient inference, lightweight deployment, and faster execution

Integrated LLM pipelines with SQL-driven automation applications and enterprise data sources, enabling intelligent query handling, automated reporting, and enhanced decision-making efficiency across business workflows.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable AI solutions & alignment with business goals and measurable impact.

PROJECTS:-

💳 Project: Text Gen for Various (4) Types of Question Gen Using LLMs (Mistral-7B) (Nov-23 to Sept-24)

LLM’s used:

Python

Mistral-7B-instruct Finetune & Pretrain

 Langchain, GGUF’s

Developed a sophisticated text generation system to create five types of questions using	the Mistral-7B Instruct model & also I used different LLM’s for various question model.

Prepared and collected a sufficient large dataset and performed pre-processing also prepared finetuned Dataset format to ensure high relevance and contextual accuracy.

Fine-tuned model with the pre-processed data, optimize it for question generation tasks.

Integrated the fine-tuned model into an application, enabling dynamic question generation based on user input.

Conducted extensive testing and validation to ensure the model's performance and reliability in various scenarios.



💳 Project: Object Detection & Tracking with YOLO (oct-24 to dec-24)

Model’s used:

Python / C++ YOLO/ONNX

Retina-Face

 Resnet / Face-net

Performed extensive data collection and preprocessing to train the model, ensuring accurate and performed Object detection for 34 suspected classes

Deployed model on cloud platforms, enabling efficient and scalable translation services.

Optimized YOLO model using and hyperparameter, achieving improve accuracy & faster inference.

Implemented object tracking with OpenCV, enhancing detection performance for video streams.

💳 Project: Speech Emotion Recognition (Nov-22 to April-23)

Developed a speech emotion recognition system utilizing the Wav2Vec model to leverage state-of-the-

Model used:

Python Wave2vec model Finetuned

 Deep learning

art speech processing techniques. Collected and processed audio data from four diverse datasets to train the model, ensuring various emotional expressions and contexts.

Fine-tuned the Wav2Vec model on the pre-processed data, achieving high accuracy in detecting and classifying emotions from speech.

Integrated the trained Wav2Vec model into a customer service application, enhancing real-time emotion recognition and response. This improved user experience & increased customer satisfaction.

💳 Project: Document Processing & RAG Pipeline using Azure Document Intelligence (Feb-25 to June-25)

Tools used:

Python, Pyodbc Azure-OpenAI Flask, Bs4, fitz

 SQL Database

Built an intelligent document processing pipeline to extract key-value pairs and text from diverse formats using Azure Document Intelligence (Form Recognizer)

Stored outputs in SQL & vector databases for semantic search, enabling downstream AI workflows.

Integrated processed data into a RAG application for context-aware query answering

Developed Flask APIs and optimized the pipeline for scalability, security, and high-volume document handling.

ChromaDB, Pypdf  Automated end-to-end document ingestion and retrieval workflow, improving processing efficiency

and reducing manual effort in enterprise use cases.

💳 Project: Document Extraction Agent & Automating with multi-Agentic system (June-25 to Sep-25)

Tools used:

LangGraph Azure, Cromadb Flask, SQL

Developed a document extraction agent system using LangChain and LangGraph, enabling to processing of input files, SOPs, and prompts to extract structured and unstructured data.

Stored and managed extracted data in SQL and Chroma vector databases, integrating with a RAG- based retrieval system for context-aware query answering and intelligent information access.

Finally, this is integrated with a multi-agent AI system for dynamic use across various applications.

💳 Project: Heart Arrhythmia detection by using MIT-BIH ECG Bio signal (Sept-21 to Aprl-22)

Algorithms used:

Python LSTM-CNN

MIT-BIH data Deep learning

Developed an arrhythmia detection system utilizing the MIT-BIH ECG bio signal dataset to identify and prevent heart-related and cardiovascular diseases.

Implemented advanced signal processing and machine learning techniques to accurately detect various arrhythmias, enhancing early diagnosis and intervention.

Conducted comprehensive validation and testing to ensure the system's reliability and accuracy, contributing to improved patient outcomes and preventive healthcare measures.

Additionally, I have worked on several other projects during my tenure that are not listed here for brevity.

Declaration:

I hereby declare that all the information given above is true and correct to the best of my knowledge. Date:	Thanks & Regards,

Place:	(M Penchala Prasad Rao)
